basis: Selected ETH-family adapter balances, signed and overlapping across protocol layers; not unique capital, complete market NAV or a global net total.
eth_ref_label: ETH at the adapter-date reference price
price_normalization_sentence: Each adapter USD balance is divided by Lido's same-date implied ETH price; this is a value equivalent, not a count of physically backed ETH.
freshness_policy: Primary sums include observations no older than 72 hours; stale and missing product observations retain their status and original values. No missing value is filled with zero.

categories.label: Staking / restaking
categories.scope: Staking issuers and restaking collateral layers; overlapping claims, not unique ETH.
categories.how: ETH earns validator income; restaking can add paid security-service income or incentives. Restaking claims can reuse an LST counted at its issuer.
categories.payer: Consensus issuance, transaction tips and MEV; additional service payers and reward sponsors where evidenced.
categories.yield_scope: Issuer or product returns vary. A reward token or points balance is not automatically ETH income.

categories.label: ETH borrowing loops
categories.scope: Examined ETH-debt loop products. Adapter exposure is not independently reconciled product NAV.
categories.how: Borrow ETH against an LST, buy more staking exposure and retain the staking income left after ETH interest and costs.
categories.payer: Underlying staking income less ETH borrowing costs; external rewards are separate.
categories.yield_scope: Compare ETH book share-price returns with unlevered staking on matched dates.

categories.label: USD carry / hybrid parents
categories.scope: Parent protocol exposures associated with examined dollar-carry designs. Whole parent exposure is not allocated carry equity.
categories.how: Keep ETH-family collateral, borrow dollars and invest the dollars. Hybrid parents also contain loops and other positions; their full adapter balances are displayed as parents.
categories.payer: Collateral staking income plus dollar investment income, less dollar funding and costs; rewards and credit exposures require lookthrough.
categories.yield_scope: Parent returns and current sleeve disclosures differ from measured carry profit or historical carry allocation.

categories.label: Spot / short basis
categories.scope: ETH spot hedged by short derivatives. No basis exposure measured at T in the frozen adapter ledger.
categories.how: Hold ETH spot or staking assets and short ETH derivatives to earn basis or funding while reducing price exposure.
categories.payer: Derivative counterparties and any staking leg, after hedge, custody and margin costs.
categories.yield_scope: A dollar return on hedged ETH backing is not an ETH-long staking return. The separate Ethena disclosure is dated after T.
categories.empty_means: Not measured at T, not zero market capital.

categories.label: Fixed yield
categories.scope: Selected ETH-related balances in yield markets; not outstanding PT principal or independently reconciled SY backing.
categories.how: Buy a principal claim at a discount and redeem its accounting unit at maturity. Yield-token trading and liquidity provision are different positions.
categories.payer: Underlying yield and the discount paid for a maturity claim; rewards and LP fees are separate.
categories.yield_scope: Yield depends on maturity, purchase price, accounting unit and exit route; a protocol-wide APY is not defined.

categories.label: Liquidity / farming / other vaults
categories.scope: ETH-family inventory in trading/bridge pools and managed protocols whose full strategy allocation is unverified.
categories.how: Provide liquidity for fees or deploy ETH through managed strategies. Unclassified managed products stay in a separate subtype rather than being assigned to carry.
categories.payer: Trading or transfer fees, strategy income and separately identified incentive sponsors.
categories.yield_scope: Pool rewards, fee income and mixed managed-product returns vary; token emissions and points need separate treatment.

categories.label: Lending markets
categories.scope: ETH loan assets, lending receipts and collateral. Optional contextual layer; it overlaps issuer and managed-product balances.
categories.how: Supply ETH or an ETH claim to a lending venue. Supplied assets may earn interest; collateral alone does not establish lender interest.
categories.payer: Borrowers pay supply interest where a loan asset is lent. Collateral can separately retain staking income.
categories.yield_scope: ETH lending can earn material income. Default exclusion is an overlap/presentation choice, not a claim that ETH lending pays zero.

categories.label: CDP collateral
categories.scope: ETH-family collateral in stablecoin-issuance and self-repaying-debt systems, not evidence of reinvested dollar proceeds.
categories.how: Post ETH or an ETH claim to issue a stablecoin or borrow against future yield. Income-bearing collateral may retain staking income.
categories.payer: Collateral yield or specific protocol incentives where evidenced; stablecoin issuance alone creates no investment income.
categories.yield_scope: A CDP is not automatically carry. Dollar proceeds must be traced to an income-producing destination.
